summary_en: France Bed Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 900,000 shares (2.7% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥1.0 billion from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027, via ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases to enhance capital efficiency and return capital to shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, France Bed Holdings' Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 459, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Companies Act based on the company's Articles of Incorporation. The company may acquire up to 900,000 shares (representing 2.7% of outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026) for an aggregate maximum purchase price of ¥1.0 billion during the period from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The acquisition will be conducted through two methods: ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange block trades) and purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 1,375,264 treasury shares against 34,747,500 shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares).

The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance capital efficiency while providing capital returns to shareholders as part of its overall capital allocation strategy.
